info.title: Phantom fleet HTTP API
info.description:
Machine-readable contract for the Phantom hub's fleet-facing HTTP API (`phm verse`). Paths cover every route the remote phone gateway admits (src/core/web/remote-gateway-policy.ts) plus hub-only routes under the fleet, leader, release-pr and runs-history prefixes. See docs/FLEET-API.md for the prose guide and docs/api/FLEET-RUNS-V1.md for the runs projection.

Auth: GETs take the read token in `X-Ashlr-Token`; writes take the separate mutation token plus `Content-Type: application/json`. Writes flagged `x-phantom-step-up: true` additionally require a step-up-approved remote session on the phone gateway. Operations flagged `x-phantom-local-only: true` are served by the hub but are deliberately not reachable through the remote gateway. Errors use the `ErrorEnvelope` schema (`{ code, error }`).

get.summary: Server-sent event stream for verse session changes.

post.summary: Approve a pending proposal (applies it, confirmed).
Reject a pending proposal.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response; remote gateway requires it to be the only parameter.

Approve or discard an agent's proposed plan.
Stop the fleet's authority, or switch the autonomy mode. Hub-only extra: `clear-stop`.

get.summary: Shadow-decision view of the authority ledger.

post.summary: Set the fleet budget mode.

get.summary: Checkpoint turn roots for a chat.
Diff a checkpoint turn against its parent (or a single file within it).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Optional repo-relative file path (no absolute paths, `.`/`..` segments or control characters).

Dismiss a finished cloud task locally (no GitHub action).

get.summary: Hub control snapshot (dispatch posture, caps, runtime).

Release a lane hold (returns updated LaneTargetsV1).

Tail of a fleet run's captured output (FleetRunLogV1).

post.summary: Resume a held repo. The hub also accepts `pause-repo` locally; the remote gateway forwards only `resume-repo`.

get.summary: Recent operator inbox entries (FleetInboxReadV1, or null when the inbox is missing).

text.description: Remote gateway bound (UTF-8 bytes); the hub itself allows 6000 characters after trimming.

get.summary: Active and recently retired operator directives.

get.summary: Order trace: directives → leader runs → jobs (OrderTraceV1).
One Leader question with typed-form metadata.

post.summary: Answer a Leader question, free-text or typed submission.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Message id or ISO time cursor; remote gateway requires `limit=50` alongside.

post.summary: Append an operator message to the Leader thread.
Queue a turn on a session (optionally send immediately).
Send one held queued turn now.

get.summary: Per-lane truth verdicts (held with capacity / reset detected / idle with work / ok / unknown) with the newest meter sample.

post.summary: Create a session bound to a project path and seat.
Cancel the session's running turn.

get.summary: Server-sent event tail for one session.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only events with seq greater than this value.

post.summary: Terminate a Devin-backed session for good (confirmed).
Send a turn to a session (202 on acceptance).

readToken.name: X-Ashlr-Token
readToken.description: Read token printed by `phm verse`, or a browser read session.

mutationToken.name: X-Ashlr-Token
mutationToken.description: Separate mutation token; the read token cannot authorize writes.

AuthorityLedgerDecisions.description: Shadow-decision ledger view — see readShadowDecisions in src/core/verse/authority-api.ts.

AuthorityStatusV1.description: AuthorityStatusV1 plus the action result — see src/core/verse/authority-api.ts.

CheckpointsRead.description: Checkpoint turn roots — see VerseCheckpointTurnRoot in src/core/verse/checkpoint-types.ts.

CloudTaskActionResult.description: { ok, task, message? } — see landCloudPr/closeCloudPr in src/core/cloud/pr-actions.ts.

DaemonActionResult.description: Daemon action outcome — see runVerseDaemonAction via src/core/verse/control-api.ts.

FleetControlActionResultV1.description: FleetControlActionResultV1 { ok, action, did, needs, mode?, state } — see src/core/fleet/fleet-control-types.ts.

FleetInboxPostResult.description: { ok, at, accepted, duplicate, dedupeKey } — 201 on first post, 200 with duplicate:true inside the dedupe window.

FleetLiveActionResult.description: FleetLiveActionResult { ok, note, changes, snapshot } — see src/core/verse/fleet-live-api.ts.

InboxDecisionResult.description: The decided proposal object — see POST /api/inbox/:id/(approve|reject) in src/core/web/api.ts.

LeaderActionResult.description: Action-dependent result ({ result, state } for veto, { dismissed } for dismiss) — see src/core/verse/leader-api.ts.

LeaderDirectivesRead.description: { directives, retired } of OperatorDirective — see src/core/vision/leader-thread-types.ts.

ReleasePrResponseV1.description: ReleasePrResponseV1 { v, generatedAt, sourceState, repos } — see src/core/verse/ops-release-pr-api.ts.

RemoteDevicesRead.description: { v, generatedAt, sourceState, devices } — see src/core/verse/fleet-control-api.ts.

VerseEventStream.description: text/event-stream of verse events — see src/core/verse/verse-stream.ts.

VerseQueueMutationResult.description: VerseQueueResponse plus sentTurnId when a turn was sent — see src/core/verse/session-controls-api.ts.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Most routes answer { code, error }; a few answer { code, reason } or { error } alone.

code.description: Machine code such as VERSE_INVALID, INBOX_REFUSED, LEADER_BUSY.

reason.description: Refusal reason on routes that use it (e.g. INBOX_REFUSED).

FleetRunsV1.description: Contract documented field-by-field in docs/api/FLEET-RUNS-V1.md and schema/fleet-runs.v1.schema.json.

sources.description: Per-source state: healthy | degraded | missing | not-landed.

LeaderQuestionSubmission.description: Typed question submission — parseLeaderQuestionSubmission in src/core/vision/leader-question-submission.ts. Exactly one of the two shapes, no extra keys.
